layout_and_structure.header: Sticky glassmorphic top header (bg-[#0A0B0E]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 z-50)

layout_and_structure.hero_zone: Large 'THE ZONE' heading, Robinhood Chain badge, protocol TVL, total burned INC, active incubations counter

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Inc.hood branding: replace all pokeball/pokemon references with Quantum Incubation Pods (hardware pods for RWA yield synthesis).
Ensure the Robinhood Chain aesthetic is present (sharp neon green accent #00C805, obsidian dark background, high precision metrics).
Provide interactive demo capabilities: editable INC balance, fast-forward 2-hour incubation, instant RWA reveal animation with random nominal values.
Include explicit 75% return / 25% burn calculation and breakdown modal when incubation completes.
Add testid attributes (data-testid) to all key interactive elements and state displays.
Implement Sonner toasts for incubation status, rewards, and demo settings updates.
